variants.name: 長い名前の指定の curl・式の形の if

verify:
name: deploy
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build
      - name: 本番に配る
        run: npm run deploy
      - name: 動いているか確かめる
        run: curl --fail --silent --show-error https://reserve.example/health
      - name: 前の版を消す
        run: npm run prune
rollback:
name: deploy
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build
      - name: 本番に配る
        run: npm run deploy
      - name: 動いているか確かめる
        run: curl --fail --silent --show-error https://reserve.example/health
      - name: 前の版を消す
        run: npm run prune
      - name: 切り戻す
        if: ${{ failure() }}
        run: npm run rollback

variants.name: 名前を付けない手順・curl -f

verify:

name: deploy
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build

      - run: curl -f https://reserve.example/health

rollback:

wrong.why: 確かめを前の版を消した後に置く
input:
name: deploy
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build
      - name: 本番に配る

      - name: 前の版を消す

      - name: 配った後に確かめる
